Ben — quick status from ops/eng:

What we found
- The invite generator currently emits a plain-text fallback containing the full Coupa URL (long query string with tokens). For HTML emails we also include a clickable anchor, but some recipients receive the plain-text part only (or their client prefers it).
- Gmail and some mobile clients insert soft line breaks in long plain-text URLs; the token gets broken mid-parameter which results in 404 at our redirect layer.

Immediate mitigations we pushed
- Ops created a short redirect link (rwd.co/invite/<token>) for AcmeStack invites and re-sent the invite via the admin console. That link resolves to the same acceptance page and preserves the token server-side.
- We also added angle brackets around the full URL in the plain-text block (i.e. <https://...>) which reduces wrapping on a number of clients.

Next steps (recommended)
- Rafael will update the template in the email-service to always emit the plain-text link wrapped in angle brackets and include a short rwd.co redirect in the plain-text body for any invite > 100 chars.
- Add a retry-on-404 in our redirect handler that attempts to reconstruct broken query strings by stripping whitespace and reassembling tokens (low risk fallback).

ETA: short links live and invite resent at 2027-04-19 10:48 PDT. Rafael will open a change PR for the template rules and add ONB-4523 to the sprint.
